## Stages

Order follows your partner's ranking (O1 → O2 → O3), which is also the dependency order: each outcome consumes the one before it. The four later stages add the qualities that the core and outcome stages leave out. They come after O3 so that each one covers all three outcomes at once, and scheduling and deployment come last, after the system they deploy is complete.

- [ ] Stage 1: Index table
      Objective: Ingest the real quarterly and daily master indexes into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing; the package scaffolds only
      Produces: the filing-index table and its location; an SEC client that later stages reuse for all SEC requests; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: one table holds the rows of every ingested quarterly and daily index, and the row counts match the source files; the findings file records the wall time, request count, bytes downloaded and table size of the real run
      Leaves out: manifests and provenance → Stage 4; point-in-time reconciliation of quarterly corrections → Stage 5; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submissions download
      Objective: Download the individual submissions that the index table's rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table and SEC client
      Produces: the submissions on disk, locatable from their index rows; a record of which rows are downloaded, pending or failed
      Exit: every index row in the stage's chosen range has its submission downloaded or is listed as pending or failed; the measured download rate and bytes per submission of the real run are recorded
      Leaves out: manifests and provenance → Stage 4; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick the 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloaded submissions and their download record
      Produces: extracted main documents for 10-K and 8-K filings, linked to their index rows
      Exit: each downloaded 10-K and 8-K submission has its main document extracted, or is listed with the reason it was not; the measured extraction time and output size of the real run are recorded
      Leaves out: manifests and provenance → Stage 4; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests and provenance
      Objective: Make every index row, submission and extracted document traceable to the exact source bytes it came from, and replayable from retained raw files.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (adds manifests and provenance)
      Consumes: Stages 1–3's outputs
      Produces: manifests and provenance for all three outputs; replay from retained raw files without SEC requests
      Exit: any output row or document names its source file and content hash; a parser-version change rebuilds the outputs from retained raw files with zero SEC requests
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Point-in-time reconciliation
      Objective: Re-read quarterly indexes and account for later SEC changes without losing earlier versions.
      Outcomes: O1 (adds point-in-time reconciliation of quarterly corrections)
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests and provenance
      Produces: versioned filing-index generations with a recorded change history
      Exit: a re-read of a changed quarterly index records its additions, updates and withdrawals, and the previous version stays readable
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the three outcomes and their hardening with committed fixtures and mocked SEC responses.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (adds full validation suite)
      Consumes: Stages 1–5's outputs
      Produces: a CI suite that runs without SEC access
      Exit: CI passes on fixtures covering malformed, legacy, empty-listing and throttled-response cases, and makes no SEC requests
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and periodic reconciliation unattended in the deployed environment.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (adds scheduling and deployment)
      Consumes: Stages 1–6's outputs; the ADR's platform decision, once accepted
      Produces: the deployed, scheduled pipeline and its operating runbooks
      Exit: two consecutive scheduled daily runs, and one scheduled reconciliation, complete in the deployed environment and are recorded in their run reports
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
